text:
jordan: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a tiny, battle-tested runbook and a shippable triage script for the overnight model-load spikes that caused short 503 windows. goal: ship within 2 weeks and run a tabletop with on-call.

jordan: proposed owner split (short):
- compact runbook (prescriptive steps + escalation ladder). owner: mira. due: 2024-12-10
- triage CLI `rb-triage` (health, metric pulls, logs, restart hints). owner: felix. due: 2024-12-10
- cron warmup job to pre-load models at 23:50. owner: eng-platform. due: 2024-12-12
- fallback route: route to standby variant when model-load errors spike. owner: jordan. due: 2024-12-17

jordan: triage CLI definition (minimum):
```sh
# check service health
curl -fsS https://api.redwood-infer/health || echo "health: FAIL"
# metrics (p50/p95 load + error rate). reads METRICS_KEY from env or vault
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p50" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p95" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=request_error_rate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
# quick logs (last 300 lines)
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=300
# hint: capture last model-load ERROR lines
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=500 | grep -i "model load" -n | tail -n 50
```

mira: I'll take the runbook. short-first approach: one-page checklist for on-call with exact commands and escalation steps (0m channel, 2m pager, 10m phone). expanded appendix for SREs with full diagnostics. will open `docs/playbooks/compact-model-load.md`.

felix: taking `rb-triage`. will implement `--quick` and `--verbose` modes, prompt for METRICS_KEY if missing, and include a `--copy-clipboard` flag to copy the captured logs reference to clipboard for quicker ticketing. won't store tokens.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-351. Epic: RINF-562 created.

jordan: please reference RINF-562 in PRs. prefer short PRs: triage script + unit test, runbook doc, cronjob PR, fallback routing PR. I'll gate reviews on linking to the epic.

mira: question: should the short runbook include `kubectl rollout restart` commands or leave that to SRE? i want a safe restart hint but not the full restart unless authorized.

jordan: include the safe restart command and a clear abort/rollback checklist. mark restart as secondary action (do after 5m of confirmed model-load errors). add exact command snippets.

felix: small ask: do we have a read-only metrics endpoint token to use in examples, or should scripts always prompt/use secrets?

jordan: always prompt or read from on-call vault. no examples with real tokens. add a note in the runbook: "do not hardcode secrets".

eng-sre-bot: Tabletop scheduled: 2024-12-08 16:00 UTC.

mira: i'll draft the compact runbook today and drop a PR for review.

felix: aim to post a first-pass `rb-triage` gist by tomorrow morning. will include tests for the metrics parsing.

jordan: great. once PRs land, we'll rehearse with an on-call engineer and collect friction notes. keep language prescriptive and "action-first" for the top of the doc.

mira: noted. :white_check_mark:

felix: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: tabletop rehearsal added to calendar.
